newsitem.title: USA: Ansys sees Q4 revs below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Ansys sees Q4 revs below estimates.

text.p: Ansys Inc said Wednesday it expects revenue for the fourth quarter ending December 31 to total about $12.3 million, or about 90 percent of published estimates by analysts.
This estimate represents an increase in total revenue of about seven percent over the fourth quarter of the previous year, Ansys said.
The company's fourth-quarter operating margin percentage, excluding amortization, is expected to remain at or above 30 percent of revenue, which the company said is in line with prior 1996 quarters.

"The fourth quarter revenue level was primarily attributable to weaker than expected sales of our core software products and related services in several European and Asian countries," said Peter Smith, chief executive officer.
Ansys said it expects to report results for the fiscal year ended December 31 on February 17.
